note: PatternVault capture profiles (SPEC §7 'PatternVault capture profiles', §4 LensForge). Thresholds are advisory heuristics [INFERENCE C-38], not measured against a reconstruction run: nothing here has been validated end-to-end because SplatForge/photogrammetry are not built (C12 stub).

metrics.sharpness: variance of the 4-neighbour Laplacian over interior pixels of the gray image
metrics.exposure: mean gray, plus fractions of pixels <=5 (dark clip) and >=250 (bright clip)

burst.describe: short burst of stills; best-of selection by sharpness

orbit.describe: walk around one object (photogrammetry / MeshWeaver input)
